#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <atomic>
#include <stdexcept>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::atomic<int> result(0);
    
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to read input");
    }
    
    int i = 0;
    int n = line.length();
    while (i < n) {
        int j = i;
        char ch = line[i];
        while (j < n && line[j] == ch) {
            j++;
        }
        result.fetch_add((j - i + 1) % 2);
        i = j;
    }
    
    std::cout << result.load() << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
